utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might shift a little this week—did you still want me to keep you posted?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please keep me posted—just confirm if the time changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — if the time changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll tell everyone the carpool plan and make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I might miss a detail or two, so that helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and keep it clear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s say 7:15 — I’ll swing by a few minutes after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be ready at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, I’m free for the carpool if you still need another rider.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, perfect — thanks, Rey! I still need one more rider, so you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can coordinate the carpool this week if you send me the school times and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send you the school times and pickup details right now. Thanks for coordinating it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you — once I have them, I’ll line everything up and confirm the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear pickup time and route for the carpool, so I can plan my day around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, of course — I’ll send you the pickup time and the route in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll wait for your message and then I can plan the rest of my day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m putting together the carpool and wanted to see if you’d like a spot. If you’re in, I can send the details right over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That might work, but I’d need the pickup time and route first so I can make sure it fits.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the pickup time and route right over so you can see if it works for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't heard the latest on the carpool yet — what's the update?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got the pickups lined up for this week, and I’m just confirming a couple of seats. I’ll send you the final schedule as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — just send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and which kids are in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I don’t have the details in front of me right now, but I can check and send you the pickup time and the kids in the carpool shortly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — please send the pickup time and the kids when you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do the carpool. Just tell me the time and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll text you the time and pick-up spot a little later.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need. Just let me know what time and where to be.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Can you do 7:30 by the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, 7:30 by the community center works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the carpool route and pick-up spots if you want—just tell me the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — let’s start with the first stop at my place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve got your place as the first stop. I’ll note the rest of the route as we go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need a ride, I can help with the carpool and lend a hand however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate it — I’ll let you know if I need a spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just holler when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do the carpool, but I need to know the exact pickup time and who’s going where first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact pickup time and the route first? I want to make sure we’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — I just need the exact pickup time and the full route, then I can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m happy to help coordinate the carpool—who all needs a ride and what time works best?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I think we need rides for Sam and Lina, and 7:30 works best for us.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll line up a ride for Sam and Lina at 7:30 and keep you posted if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing, Dane — I’ll keep an eye on the carpool supplies and make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — appreciate you keeping an eye on it. I’ll try not to show up too late this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — I’ll have everything ready, just try to be on time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool timing might be shifting a bit this week—want me to keep an ear out for the exact schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please—that would be really helpful. I’m trying to keep the school pickup times straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the exact pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what time are we picking up the kids?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s do 7:45 — that gives us a little cushion before school starts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, 7:45 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — weekdays would work best, around 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me — I can do weekdays at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. Let’s coordinate the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing — I can spread the word about the carpool and see who’s in. Want me to invite the neighbors I usually chat with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — that’d be great. I’m still catching up on everyone, so any help spreading the word is appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start asking around today and let you know who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spot and time—what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Opal. Let’s meet at the front curb at 7:30, and I’ll text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — front curb at 7:30, and I’ll keep an eye out for your text if plans change.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the carpool tomorrow, and what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, we’re still on for tomorrow. Could you be ready by 7:30 AM?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready and waiting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I heard the carpool might need one more driver this week. Want me to check if my schedule can help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Ira — thanks for checking. I might’ve mixed up the days, so your help would really save me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll check my errands and see if I can take a day.
